zh: 提词器（we-ai）新增 6 分钟与 8 分钟精简演讲版本切换（含自动配音、单页计时预估与逐句过滤联动），同步更新内置工具使用指南。
新增 12 路 6 分钟/8 分钟中英阿三语精简配音及对齐音轨（we-ai-narration-short-20261123 / we-ai-narration-aligned-20261123）。
对齐基座版能力：智能体新增只读页面配置查询工具（read_page_config，白名单与权限管控、密钥自动脱敏），save_skill 保存后自动回读校验确保落盘可靠。
共享会话链接弹窗支持内联状态与错误提示、非阻塞拼音搜索，并完善跨标签页账号切换时的会话列表刷新守卫。
en: Added 6-minute and 8-minute abridged speech editions to the teleprompter (we-ai) with narration switching, per-slide time estimates, and updated built-in tool guides.
Added 12 multilingual 6m/8m abridged and aligned narration tracks across Chinese, English, and Arabic (we-ai-narration-short-20261123 / we-ai-narration-aligned-20261123).
Aligned capabilities with Base Edition: added read-only read_page_config tool (allowlisted, permission-scoped, and secret-masked) and post-save readback verification for save_skill.
Enhanced shared-conversation link dialogs with inline status/error feedback and non-blocking pinyin loading, plus cross-tab account identity guards for conversation lists.
